newsitem.title: GABON: Gabon orders troops to combat schools strike.
newsitem.headline: Gabon orders troops to combat schools strike.

text.p: Gabon ordered its security forces on Thursday to intervene to maintain order in its schools in the face of a strike by teachers.
Defence Minister Iddriss Ngari said on state television that the move followed "threats to public buildings, which schools are, and to non-striking teachers."
Teachers in public elementary and high schools in the oil-producing Central African state went on strike on October 1, the official start of the academic year, over their pay and conditions.
President Omar Bongo, who returned on Thursday from a visit to Ivory Coast, said he was prepared to recruit teachers from outside the country to break the strike.
